name: Stacked rice sheets
summary: One ultra-thin hot rice sheet comes on each plate, brushed with scallion fat and dusted with chives and dried-shrimp powder. You roll it around grilled pork, sausage, pickles, mango, and Thai basil, and stack the empty plates as you go.
origin: Vietnam National Administration of Tourism calls bánh ướt chồng đĩa a Buon Ma Thuot specialty, served one sheet to a plate.
howToEat: Dip each roll in mắm nêm or a sweet-sour fish sauce, or mắm mặn where it is offered. People eat 10 to 20 plates, sometimes more than 30.
where: Trần Nhật Duật and Lê Thánh Tông.
seoTitle: Banh uot chong dia in Buon Ma Thuot — one sheet a plate
seoDescription: One hot rice sheet a plate, rolled with grilled pork, sausage, pickles, and mango on Tran Nhat Duat or Le Thanh Tong.
